purpose: Prevent JSON lexical spelling from being mistaken for a Python or Julia runtime numeric type.
accepted_number_rule: A JSON number is accepted when the parser value is an integer or finite floating value but not a Boolean. Consumers normalize it to binary64 and verify the declared bit authority when one exists.

extended_real_tokens.rule: Extended values are tagged strings only; NaN and nonstandard Infinity JSON numbers are forbidden.

cross_runtime_gate: Python exact-rational fma emulation and Julia Base.fma must produce every result_bits value; JSON consumers must accept integral-real-token as a real despite its integer lexical form.
